integrityRecord.numericPortTreatment: the titration worked example is a verbatim port of the source results table: rough titre 15.50 cm3 discarded, the concordant pair 14.90 and 15.00 cm3 used, mean computed as (14.90 + 15.00) / 2 = 14.95 in a single-equals arithmetic line shaped for the shunting-yard scanner (the copy-it red line held: no number invented — every figure is the table's). Superscript treatment: the U+00B3 glyph is used in the prompt/steps/finalAnswer so the final-answer value trace sees only the true numbers (a plain "cm3" would inject an untraceable 3 into the trace; the glyph is not an ASCII digit to the scanner).
integrityRecord.nonNumericPortTreatment: the Oxidation & Reduction worked example is a verbatim port of the source Worked Example block (V3+ + Fe3+ giving V4+ + Fe2+): two-step structure kept (identify each species change, then label oxidation/reduction), no arithmetic present in the source, so the lint's no-arithmetic warning is the designed declaration of record.
